title: 第5章 夺回碎片第6章 刺杀失败
content_zh:
天牢位于大夏国皇城西郊，当楚峰来到这里时，城门早已经关闭。
而城墙之上，还有着士兵把守。
“试试隐身能力！”
楚峰体内，造化之力涌动，很快便将他全身包裹住。
“我真的隐身了！”
走出牢房，看着自己的身体，楚峰惊叹不已。
“那是当然，本灵岂会骗你不成？！”
葫灵得意的说道。
“如此一来，我便有把握从夏侯武那里夺回碎片了。
不过这隐身状态对造化之力的消耗也太大了吧。”
楚峰估摸着，以自己丹田内的造化之力，恐怕也就只能维持隐身状态一个时辰而已。
一个时辰之后，造化之力便会消耗殆尽。
所以，
“我必须要一个时辰内从天牢逃出去，而且还要从夏侯武手里夺回碎片。”
时间非常的紧迫，他必须分毫必争。
随后他一个纵深跳跃，翻越了城墙，进入了皇城之中。
很快，他来到一座庄园前。
庄园大门上则是贴着两张封条。
上方匾额上则写着两个大字，楚家！
“想不到我楚家为大夏国立下无数汗马功劳，却落得如此下场！

夏侯武，夏皇，此仇，我楚峰不报誓不为人！”
楚峰心中怒吼一声，随后从大门一侧翻墙进入。
在寻找了几处房间之后，他终于找到了一件下人的衣服，和一把黑色的精铁匕首。
换上衣服之后，他出了楚家，朝着皇宫西侧而去。
“夏侯瑜，夏侯武，我来复仇了，你们准备好了吗？”
楚峰之所以先去西侧，便是想要先去见一见夏侯瑜，了断两人之间的恩怨。
如果他先去夏侯武那里，恐怕就没有时间和机会来找夏侯瑜了。
只是，
夏侯瑜不在。
心中略有失望，楚峰便直奔东宫而去。
一炷香后，他来到了夏侯武居住的宫殿之外。
太子的宫殿，自然会有侍卫守卫。
但是对于隐身状态的楚峰而言，如同虚设。
很快，他便摸到了夏侯武的房间之外。
此刻的夏侯武早已经睡下，根本就没有察觉到有人靠近。
只是，楚峰此刻也有些犯难了。
夏侯武的房门紧闭，就连窗户都已经被锁上，他想要无声的进入其中，根本就不可能。
“葫灵前辈，有没有什么办法让我悄无声息的进去？”
楚峰只得请教葫灵。
“没办法，只能硬闯，有造化之力在，你怕什么，打不赢还可以逃走。”

楚峰一愣，随后一想，的确是如此。
他紧握匕首，将窗户拨开，然后猛然窜了进去。
而就在他拨动窗户的那一刻，夏侯武便惊醒了过来。
content_en:
Tianlao is located on the western outskirts of the Imperial City of Daxia. When Chu Feng arrived here, the city gate had already been closed.
There are still soldiers guarding the city wall.
"Try your invisibility!"
Within Chu Feng's body, the power of creation surged and soon enveloped his whole body.
"I'm really invisible!"
After walking out of the cell and looking at his body, Chu Feng was amazed.
"Of course, how could I lie to you?!"
Hu Ling said proudly.
“In this way, I will be sure to take back the fragments from Xia Houwu.
However, this invisible state consumes too much of the power of creation. "
Chu Feng estimated that with the power of creation in his dantian, he might only be able to maintain his invisibility for an hour.
After an hour, the power of creation will be exhausted.
So,
"I have to escape from the prison within an hour, and I have to get the fragments back from Xiahou Wu."
Time was very tight and he had to fight for every cent.
Then he made a deep jump, climbed over the city wall, and entered the imperial city.
Soon, he came to a manor.
There are two seals on the gate of the manor.
There are two big characters written on the plaque above, Chu Family!
“I didn’t expect that my Chu family had made countless contributions to Daxia, but we ended up like this!
Xia Houwu, Emperor Xia, I, Chu Feng, will not be human unless I take revenge for this! "
Chu Feng roared in his heart, then climbed over the wall from the side of the gate and entered.
After searching several rooms, he finally found a servant's clothes and a black fine iron dagger.
After changing his clothes, he left the Chu family and headed towards the west side of the palace.
"Xia Houyu, Xia Houwu, I'm here for revenge, are you ready?"
The reason why Chu Feng went to the west side first was to meet Xia Houyu first and settle the grudge between the two.
If he went to Xia Houwu first, he might not have the time or opportunity to find Xia Houyu.
Just,
Xia Houyu is not here.
Feeling slightly disappointed, Chu Feng went straight to the East Palace.
After burning an incense stick, he arrived outside the palace where Xiahou Wu lived.
The prince's palace will naturally be guarded by guards.
But for Chu Feng, who was in the invisible state, it was like a fake.
Soon, he felt outside Xia Houwu's room.
At this moment, Xia Houwu had already gone to bed and did not notice anyone approaching at all.
However, Chu Feng was also in trouble at this moment.
Xia Houwu's door was closed, and even the windows were locked. It was impossible for him to enter silently.
"Senior Hu Ling, is there any way for me to go in quietly?"
Chu Feng had no choice but to ask Hu Ling for advice.
"I have no choice but to force my way in. With the power of creation, what are you afraid of? If you can't win, you can still escape."
Chu Feng was stunned for a moment, and then thought about it, it was indeed the case.
He held the dagger tightly, opened the window, and rushed in suddenly.
And the moment he opened the window, Xia Houwu woke up with a start.
